resources.string: A write may have reached the radio. Reconnect and review its current configuration before retrying.
Disconnect the radio and wait for it to finish disconnecting. If you still cannot import, restart the app and try again.
When the radio reconnects, synchronization may delete restored channel history if its channel configuration differs. Restore the radio configuration first.
The radio accepted the contact, but it could not be saved locally. Retry the import.
Could not access the selected file. Check its availability and permissions, then try again.
Could not open the file picker. Close any open picker, check that a file manager is available, and try again.
